execution: unexecuted source and failure-injection fixtures; static-only boundary

cases.name: base-absent
cases.expect: base desktop and non-DevOps server plans do not stage the build cache unit, firmware login fragment or DevOps account activation

cases.name: wrong-artifact-architecture
cases.expect: Bazelisk and BuildBuddy reject wrong-class or wrong-machine ELF before publication

cases.name: redirect-leaves-allowlist
cases.expect: shared transport rejects the destination before requesting its bytes

cases.name: existing-artifact-replaced
cases.expect: member receipt and final identity reject replacement; no reset or unrelated store cleanup

cases.name: unconfigured-project
cases.expect: Bazelisk has an error fallback; it never selects a latest Bazel release because a project version is missing

cases.name: existing-human-bazelrc
cases.expect: preserve differing file bytes and refuse implicit takeover; no arbitrary shell sourcing

cases.name: build-cache-existing-store
cases.expect: exact owner, group, directory mode and no-follow identity are required; no recreation or recursive ownership change

cases.name: build-cache-service
cases.expect: srv-devops identity, workload slice, loopback-only systemd address policy, empty capabilities and explicit operator activation; no host engine socket

cases.name: build-cache-pending
cases.expect: installation never enables or starts the service and never reports online

cases.name: calendar-malformed-private-data
cases.expect: invalid credential input is fatal, not a fallback to a public profile or account-policy default

cases.name: kernel-spi-hotplug
cases.expect: native bind is unavailable before mutation when the kernel cannot bind a held device identity; driver_override and global bind are never written

cases.name: kernel-spi-already-bound
cases.expect: read-only native ownership check does not change drivers or load modules

cases.name: firmware-unavailable-propagation
cases.expect: status 69 survives the desktop fwops adapter and does not activate a nested firmware shell
